charge_port.notes: Estimated: the 2026 Mach-E has a CCS1 port (InsideEVs) and Ford sells a NACS adapter (2025 spec sheet); the Supercharger adapter programme for 2026 owners implies the same CCS1 port. No port change found across 2021-2026.

wheels.notes: Premium: 19 in aluminum standard (Ford Canada 2026 Premium page); Ford 2025 sheet gives 19 in for Select and Premium. 2026 Select not read separately.
